findings.summary: Luna marked both accessible menu surfaces complete but recorded zero current products and zero presentation IDs. Terra independently observed current products on both surfaces, including four in-scope nonalcoholic products absent from frozen rows.

The restaurant PDF lists ingredients and asks guests to advise staff of allergies but supplies no complete allergen, may-contain, shared-equipment, or cross-contact declarations. Toast ingredient descriptions are restaurant-linked-vendor evidence, not restaurant-issued allergen evidence. Complete frozen allergen arrays and official-ingredients attribution cannot be verified.

verifier.summary: Independent primary-source review confirms Baan Siam identity and both current surfaces, but the scout’s catalog is structurally empty. No scout currentProductKey or presentationId exists to verify: currentProductCheckGroups is intentionally empty, avoiding invented/unknown scout IDs. All independently observed products are discoveries and the four products absent from the frozen catalog are reported above. The frozen catalog has menu-scope and allergen-authority discrepancies; source silence does not establish negatives or cross-contact conclusions.
coordinatorNotes: Read-only Terra result; no ledger, artifact, generated-data, repair, or terminal-state mutation performed.

The scout artifact contains zero currentProducts and zero presentationIds. Terra must not assign independently reconstructed keys or presentation IDs to currentProductCheckGroups because those fields are restricted to exact scout identifiers.
Escalate to Sol: current catalog omission, incomplete allergen disclosure, authority mismatch, cross-contact uncertainty, PDF extraction, and frozen reconciliation require adjudication.
